description: Fordon i trafik efter län och kommun samt fordonsslag. År 2002 - 2025 is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Statistikmyndigheten SCB - Statistiska centralbyrån. Vehicles in use, number by region, type of vehicle and year. Coverage: Statistikmyndigheten SCB - Statistiska centralbyrån. The portal shows the English title as "Vehicles in use by region and type of vehicles. Year 2002 - 2025" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Statistikmyndigheten SCB - Statistiska centralbyrån. Its keywords include Transport and communications, Registered vehicles, Fordonsstatistik, Transporter och kommunikationer. The listing shows 2 download or service links in JSON. The listing shows 2026-02-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
